description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): List dates in Korea: public holidays, festivals and events, or seasonal dates (autumn foliage, cherry blossom, beach opening, winter). Returns up to 30 dated lines from the start date with the check date and the page URL. Seasonal dates state which year they are from. Events are listed only once announced.

from.description: Optional start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Defaults to today in Korea.

region.description: Optional. For events, the province; for seasons, the dates for places in that region. e.g. "Seoul", "Busan".

name: get_korea_dates
title: Holidays, festivals and seasons
